name: LM 0830-015-01
description: Series LM 0830 · Stroke 15 mm · Continuous force up to 1.03 N · Position sensor Analog Hall

catalog.sourceName: FAULHABER official catalogue, dimensional drawing and CAD

specifications.label: Model scope
specifications.value: Original FAULHABER housing and stroke-specific rod CAD assembled on their common Z axis. Position is a percentage of nominal stroke, from 0% to 100%, with 50% at the center of the catalog body. It translates only the rod and is not an electrical simulation. The 11 (analog Hall) and 12 (sin/cos) sensor versions share the same 1X mechanical housing. LM0830 includes the separate terminal foil provided in supplier CAD. Rod length is not stroke; mounting dimensions and terminal projections follow supplier CAD. Optional guides, cables and controllers are excluded. The supplier installation models do not resolve internal magnets, coils or sensors.
